Method of Attack: Execute commands on the server via content uploaded to the Jakarta Multipart parser component
Disable Linux and SUSE Linux firewalls
Gain persistence by adding a binary to the boot-up routine
Execute shell commands including 'whoami' to test exploit
Use of IRC bouncer, DoS bot, and Bill Gates DDoS bot malware payloads
Discoverer: Nick Biasini, Cisco Talos security researcher
Impacted Systems: Apache Struts applications using Jakarta Multipart parser
Attack Vector: Content uploaded to Jakarta Multipart parser component
Indicators of Compromise: Public proof-of-concept exploit code uploaded to a Chinese website
